title: The funnel reports its conversion rates end to end
description:
**Phase 5 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the enablement story, in the paid enablement epic
- **Runs in parallel with:** the readout tasks
- **Unblocks:** the recalibration task

---
The one story in this epic, because a funnel report is something the system produces rather than something a person concludes.

Nine transitions, each a count and a rate: home to pitch page, pitch to survey start, survey start to complete, complete to confirmed, confirmed to invited, invited to paid, paid to provisioned, provisioned to first task run, and the services-qualified count.

**Paid to provisioned is the new one and the most likely to leak.** Report it in elapsed days, not only as a rate — if the median is three weeks, provisioning is the next product problem regardless of what every other number says.

The two rates above the survey come from the marketing pages and cannot come from our own records; everything from survey start onwards does.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Beta funnel reporting

  Scenario: The funnel reports each stage transition
    Given waitlist signups at every stage of the funnel
    When the funnel report is produced
    Then it reports the count and rate for each transition from survey start to first task run
    And it reports the services-qualified count

  Scenario: Time to provision is reported in days
    Given organizations that paid and were later provisioned
    When the funnel report is produced
    Then it reports the median days from payment to provisioning
